rules.statement: A person who is entitled to a right of way without the soil right is not entitled in law to obstruct other users of the road who have no right of way to use the same.
rules.supporting_quote: The Plaintiff-Appellant who is entitled to a right of way without the soil right is not entitled in law to obstruct the Defendant-Respondents who have no right of way to use the said road, from using the same.
